messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — kicking off Celestia onboarding. Sophie from Celestia is on this thread. Goal: 30-day activation + first production inference in sandbox by day 21. Quick sync?

sophie_cust: Thanks! We're excited. Primary stakeholders: me (admin), tom_finance (billing), jia_engineering (infra). Looking to reduce latency for chat search and get embeddings workflow integrated.

maria_cs: Noted. Proposed success criteria — agree? 1) sandbox inference running with p50 <300ms for typical 512-token prompts; 2) end-to-end embedding pipeline validated and baseline vectors stored; 3) two internal users trained and producing queries.

lucas_pm: Add one more: quality threshold for reranking — ROC-AUC >= 0.85 on their eval set.

raj_se: I'll own infra tests + model config. Proposed timeline: enable workspace + API keys day 0-1, ingest sample data day 2-5, run evals day 6-9, performance tuning day 10-14, canary + go/no-go by day 21. Thoughts?

ev an_sales: FYI renewal touchpoint sits at month 9; I'd like us to track adoption metrics early (active users, avg tokens, embedding ops) so Sales has a story.

sophie_cust: One constraint — Legal needs to review data retention before we upload sample PII-ish logs.

maria_cs: Action items: - raj_se: provision sandbox & test harness by EOD tomorrow; - lucas_pm: share eval set & target metrics; - sophie_cust: confirm stakeholder list + SSO timeline; - evan_sales: confirm contract dates and renewal window. I'll run weekly standups Tue 9am PT and post calendar.

onboarding-bot: Event created: 'Celestia Onboarding Weekly' Tue 09:00 PT, invite sent to: maria_cs, raj_se, lucas_pm, sophie_cust, evan_sales

raj_se: Quick config snippet for initial smoke test:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' -d '{"model":"vicuna-13b","prompt":"<sample>","max_tokens":256}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

maria_cs: +1. Please use the private workspace and set retention to 30d for ingestion until Legal signs off.

lucas_pm: Recommend we run a 10% canary to a quantized variant to measure latency/cost delta before a full roll.

sophie_cust: Legal says retention ok if PII is scrubbed and logs are ephemeral. I'll follow up with the DPO and share checklist.

maria_cs: I'll capture these items in the kickoff doc and circulate post-thread. Any immediate blockers?

ev an_sales: None from Sales. :thumbsup:

sophie_cust: One more ask — can we schedule a 60-min enablement session on embeddings usage for two engineers next Wed?

maria_cs: Yup — scheduled, will send invite + recording afterwards.

onboarding-bot: Reminder set: 'Provision sandbox' due in 24h assigned to raj_se.

maria_cs: Thanks all — closing initial sync. I'll update the kickoff playbook with owners/timelines and link back here. :rocket:
